messages:
alex: Quick handoff note — I'm toggling a temporary routing/threshold tweak for batch-job failure alerts before I sign off. Details below.

alex: Problem: noisy flapping from short-lived k8s preemptions is spiking our pager 2s for the model-batch jobs. Want to avoid waking folks overnight for transients.

alex: Change I'm deploying in 5m:
- Increase the per-minute failure threshold from `>=5` to `>=10` for the model-batch job alert.
- Require a 10-minute sustained window (rolling) before PagerDuty trigger.
- Route the alert to `#eng-oncall-lowprio` for first 10 minutes. If it sustains, escalate to `#eng-oncall` + PD.

alex: Snippet of the alert rule I'll push (CloudMonitoring):
```
metric: "k8s/container/failures" 
filter: "resource.labels.cluster = \"prod-gpu\" AND metric.labels.job = \"model-batch\"" 
condition: "count_over_time(1m) >= 10" 
for: "10m" 
notification_channels: ["#eng-oncall-lowprio"]
escalation: "pagerduty:high"  # on sustained
```

alex: Reasoning: keeps transient preemptions visible in low-pri channel for triage, but stops immediate PD noise. Will monitor graphs during the night. :eyes:

maria: Thanks — quick Q: will the change affect our SLO alerts? could hide real regressions where batch backlog grows but failures are intermittent?

alex: Good call. I checked the backlog SLI — that alert (batch-queue-lag > 500ms) is unchanged and still routes to PD immediately. This tweak only touches the `model-batch` failure count alert.

jamal: Can you paste the runbook link? also please add me to the PD escalation for 10m window in case it trips after hours.

alex: Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/model-batch-failures (adding jamal to escalation now)

oncall-bot: Rotation change: Alex -> Ryan at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. (automated)

ryan: noted. i'll keep an eye on the queue dashboard and check the low-pri channel every 30m tonight. if anything looks off i'll promote to main channel.

sophie: I'll update the runbook note about the temporary threshold and add the config snippet. Will include a rollback step (`kubectl apply -f alert-rule.yaml`) and the timestamped changelog.

maria: :thumbsup: one more ask — can we add a short dashboard panel showing 1m vs 10m failure rate so we can see the delta at a glance?

alex: yes — adding a small panel now. i'll post a screenshot in the channel after it's live.

jamal: acked. thanks for the heads-up.

ryan: Thanks Alex. I'll pick up monitoring at handoff.

sophie: added changelog entry and linked to PR: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/412

alex: Signing off in 10. Will revert if we see missed regressions. Good night. :sleeping:
